review.reason: The main fairways, greens, hazards, lake, tees and walking connectors broadly match the numbered diagram, and the greens read as continuous natural surfaces. However, the detached Hole 1 fairway patch lacks clearly visible edge-to-edge mowing stripes, and added trees clutter the T1 carry toward its first fairway landing area.

issues.detail: The detached fairway patch to the right of T1 is visibly uniform rather than showing alternating lighter and darker stripes. Add curved, edge-to-edge bands scaled to this patch and confined to its footprint.
issues.consequence: At overview scale, the patch can read as an extra putting green or generic turf instead of a fairway section.

issues.detail: Added tree crowns cluster between T1 and the upper fairway landing area, visually cluttering the broad tee-shot corridor.
issues.consequence: The overview makes the route from T1 to its first fairway landing area appear obstructed.
